properties.name: entur.logging.request-response.grpc.map-body-on-async-appender-thread
properties.description: Whether gRPC message bodies can be mapped to JSON on the async appender's thread. Only applies with on-demand logging enabled (entur.logging.grpc.ondemand.enabled). If false, a body is mapped before the log statement is handed over to the async appender, i.e. on the thread which flushes the on-demand logging scope.
